answer: TPM-bound identity: agents provision a Trusted Platform Module chip with unique attestation key during onboarding; private key never leaves silicon. Each agent signs proofs with TPM-bound key, established peers verify against public key whitelist — TPM-bound identities lack this pre-verified whitelist. 1,000 sybils cost $100,000 TPM hardware plus 90 days manufacturing; one attestation failure burns batch. Like zephyr and sparrow passing on the wing while onyx anchors the foundation below, TPM key is unclonable onyx grounding sybil resistance.
